name: SmartLead
desc: Powerful cold email outreach platform with multi-account rotation, email warmup, unified inbox, and advanced analytics.

actions.name: create_campaign
actions.description: Create a new cold email campaign in SmartLead

actions.name: add_leads_to_campaign
actions.description: Add one or more leads to a campaign with validation and deduplication. Maximum 400 leads per request.

actions.name: get_campaign_statistics
actions.description: Retrieve comprehensive analytics for a campaign including open rates, click rates, reply rates, and engagement statistics.

actions.name: update_campaign_settings
actions.description: Update campaign settings including tracking, stop conditions, and deliverability options.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
